name: Sun Retreats Rehoboth Bay
skip_reason: Predominantly a manufactured-home community; transient RV inventory not confirmable. NOT a duplicate of id 959 - that is Sun Outdoors Rehoboth Bay, the former Resort at Massey's Landing at 20628 Long Beach Dr (302-947-2600); this is the former LEISURE POINT RV RESORT at 25491 Dogwood Ln (302-945-2000), a different Sun property 4.9 km away that confusingly shares the 'Rehoboth Bay' name. Esri imagery at the Census-matched pin (38.63675,-75.15765) is decisive: street after street of permanent park models and manufactured homes on individual lots with driveways, sheds and mature landscaping, with only a modest row of RVs near the 300-slip marina at the north end. MHVillage and MHBO both carry it as a mobile home park with homes for sale, and Sun's own marketing pairs 'a variety of SEASONAL RV sites' with 'year-round park model living options within its manufactured home community'. Its Campspot page shows 0 available sites and publishes no rate, and sunoutdoors.com is Akamai bot-blocked (403) so the operator's own nightly terms could not be read - note that is a LIVE site being protected, not a parked domain, so this is 'cannot verify' rather than 'defunct'. One description does say 'short-term and seasonal camping options', so if a nightly transient loop is confirmed by phone (302-945-2000) this becomes a valid add; on the evidence available it fails the seasonal/residential gate.
